decisions.reason: The modular plant concept already shows strong quantified customer savings (over 600,000 EUR per year), so its option value is being realized and fits the firm's strategic push toward modular solutions.
The slow-speed shredder sits close to the core offer, has its own dedicated page, and costs little to carry, so keeping it is clearly justified while demand develops.
This second modular plant concept is still early with uncertain prospects but is cheap to keep alongside A, so the option is worth holding, though it could later be merged into A.
The trommel screen is a core-adjacent product with low carrying cost and no negative signals, so there is no reason to give up the option in a growing market.
